headline: Fourth-quarter results swing to profit on Knicks title run
summary_short: Madison Square Garden Sports's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 36.7% y/y to $278.7M on record playoff-related revenue from the Knicks' NBA Championship run, and the company swung to diluted EPS of $1.16 from a $(0.07) loss a year ago.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 36.7% y/y to $278.7M (full year $1,153.8M, +11%), driven by a $66.9M jump in playoff-related revenue as the Knicks won the NBA Championship, plus higher national media-rights fees (+$7.2M), partly offset by lower local media-rights fees (-$3.5M) under amended MSG Networks agreements. Operating income swung to $32.2M from a $(22.6)M loss; adjusted operating income was $39.6M. Diluted EPS was $1.16 versus $(0.07) a year ago. Cash rose to $164.5M (+13.8% y/y); long-term debt held flat q/q at $242M ($25M lower y/y); the stockholders' deficit narrowed to $(263.3)M. No formal financial guidance was issued; the company still expects to complete the Rangers spin-off by end of October 2026.
